S.FORM: alang Kamisatu ga niya mki sku Tayto Keng atu Genhe'I go, kwara sali buwan nya ga buwan, hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga kyan ku hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga kyan ku hi nya. rhzyal kki'an lingay na Kamisatu hya' ga Kainisungan. rekisi kayal kyokay qalang Kamisatu ga ungat kyokay. ssquliq pinlpgan qalang Kamisatu ga ungat ssquliq pinlpgan . ppqbaqan qalang Kamisatu ga ungat pqwasan biru. tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ kami[s|ɕ]atu ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku tajto keŋ atu ɣenħeʔi ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa βuwan ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa kjan ku ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa kjan ku ħi nja rħzjal kkiʔan liŋaj na kami[s|ɕ]atu ħjaʔ ɣa kaini[s|ɕ]uŋan reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj qalaŋ kami[s|ɕ]atu ɣa uŋat kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan qalaŋ kami[s|ɕ]atu ɣa uŋat [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan qalaŋ kami[s|ɕ]atu ɣa uŋat pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
